description: Namespaces whose pods, events and logs the orchestrator controller may read as alert evidence. Every namespace the repository declares, and every namespace an alert rule or cluster-sentinel names, must appear in exactly one list (tests/test_orchestrator_manifests.py).

excluded.pod-agent: holds another agent's credentials and sessions
excluded.external-secrets: syncs every secret in the cluster
excluded.kube-system: cluster control plane, Traefik and CoreDNS
excluded.persistent-agent: the orchestrator itself; its own logs are not evidence
excluded.flux-system: deploy credentials and Git source access
